name: dhaka-tesla-pool
description: Ride-pooling MVP for Dhaka: passengers share a three-wheeled Tesla.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @tesla-pool/api && npm run build -w @tesla-pool/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @tesla-pool/api && npm run typecheck -w @tesla-pool/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && npm run test:unit -w @tesla-pool/api && npm run test -w @tesla-pool/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration -w @tesla-pool/api
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
